name: 1640-walk-after-host-call
about: guard-walk-1: its after hook on MarioActor::control logs eight facts through the kernel (calls of the game and the host that return), then faults two of its own frames down, in a frame whose unwritten room keeps what those calls left: resumed by the call chain, the mod off, the game goes on

expect.log: \[mod guard\-walk\-1\] GUARD: its code failed \(after hook: MarioActor::control\): a memory access it may not make at .+\+0x[0-9a-f]+, address 0x[0-9a-f]+\. It is off until the next start; what it was changing may be half done\.
